I just found Eve dead in Security. 

Here's my timeline: I passed through Security a bit earlier coming from Navigation, and it was completely clear. I then went up to Weapons, where I ran into Alice and Bob. Bob was only there briefly, but Alice stayed in Weapons with me for a couple of rounds. 

I just went back down to Security and found the body. Alice followed me into Security right as I found it. Because Alice was with me up in Weapons during the time the kill probably happened, I'm pretty sure she's clear. 

Diana, Frank, where were you two? And did anyone see Eve recently so we can narrow down the exact time she died?

I was mostly working on tasks on the left side of the ship. My route was Electrical, then up through Medbay, Upper Engine, Oxygen, and I just finished up in Lower Engine. 

I didn't buddy up with anyone, but I *did* see Eve! Around tick 7, I saw her pass through Medbay coming from Upper Engine, and she headed straight into Electrical. Since Electrical connects directly to Security, her path perfectly lines up with where you found the body, Charlie. 

If Charlie clears Alice, and I was completely isolated on the left side of the map for the second half of the round, we really need to look at Bob and Frank. Charlie mentioned Bob left Weapons briefly — Bob, did you head south towards Security? And Frank, where have you been this whole time? I'll wait to hear your answers before deciding how to vote.

To answer your question Diana, I never headed south towards Security at all. My route was almost entirely top-side this round. 

I started by heading left through Medbay to Upper Engine, and then into Oxygen. I actually saw you there, Frank, along with Alice, around tick 7. After finishing up in Oxygen, I looped back through the Cafeteria to get to Weapons. That's exactly when I bumped into Charlie and Alice. I only stayed briefly because I just had a quick task, and then I headed straight back into the Cafeteria.

Since I was never in Electrical or Security, I unfortunately don't have any clues about Eve's death. But looking at what we know: Charlie is confidently clearing Alice, which makes sense to me since I saw them together. I can vouch that Frank was top-side early on, but Frank, we really need to know where you went after Oxygen. 

Diana, you openly admit you were in Electrical, which connects directly to the scene of the crime. If Frank's path keeps him away from the bottom right of the ship, you're going to be my top suspect. I'll hold my vote to see how Frank explains his second half of the round.

Diana, you are completely caught in a lie, and your alibi is entirely fabricated.

I can 100% corroborate Bob's story. I was in Upper Engine from ticks 1 to 4 (where I saw Eve early on), and then I was in Oxygen from ticks 6 to 8. I was in Oxygen with Alice that whole time. Bob entered Oxygen at tick 6 and left towards the Cafeteria at tick 7, exactly as he just stated. 

Diana, you claim your route was up through Upper Engine and Oxygen, but I was there almost the entire round and I *never* saw you. Bob didn't see you there either. If you were actually doing tasks on the left side of the ship, you would have crossed paths with me, Alice, or Bob. 

Charlie confidently clears Alice, and I can confirm both Bob and Alice were top-side with me when Eve likely died. Diana, you openly admitted to being in Electrical early on, which connects directly to Security where Charlie found the body. You killed Eve and made up this route to try and frame me or Bob. 

Alice, you're speaking next — you can confirm you were with me in Oxygen. We need to vote out Diana.

Charlie, thanks for the vouch. I can confirm we were together in Weapons, and I walked down to Security right behind you when you found Eve.

Frank, your entire accusation against Diana is completely flawed, and the fact that you pushed it so aggressively makes you my top suspect. You claimed Diana was lying about her route because you "never saw her" in Oxygen. But you just told us you were only in Oxygen from ticks 6 to 8. I stayed in Oxygen longer than you, and I literally watched Diana walk into Oxygen from Upper Engine at tick 10! Her alibi is 100% genuine; you just weren't there anymore to see her.

What's even more glaring is that you conveniently ignored Bob's question. You accounted for your time up to tick 8, but where exactly were you for the entire second half of the round? You had more than enough time to head down toward Security and kill Eve, whose timeline of heading south matches perfectly. 

You just tried to fabricate a hole in Diana's story to push a mislynch and distract us from the fact that you have no alibi for the time of the murder. Diana is clear in my book. We need to vote Frank.

Frank
Frank

Alice, I appreciate you defending my alibi, but I have to be completely honest with everyone: I did NOT see you in Oxygen. If you were really still in Oxygen at tick 10 like you claim, I would have seen you when I entered. You are fabricating that detail to push a vote onto Frank. 

Frank, you didn't see me in Oxygen between ticks 6 and 8 because I wasn't there yet — I literally just told everyone I saw Eve in Medbay at tick 7. Our timelines just didn't overlap. Your aggressive push on me was based on a flawed assumption, but Alice's defense of me is a flat-out lie.

Charlie, you said Alice followed you into Security when you found the body, and you cleared her because she was in Weapons with you. But if Alice is lying about being in Oxygen at tick 10, how did she get to Weapons? More importantly, Charlie, you passed through Security, went to Weapons, and came back. You easily could have killed Eve during your first pass through Security, ran to Weapons to build a fake alibi with Alice and Bob, and then "discovered" the body. 

I know Frank looks bad for attacking me and not giving his late-round path, but Alice's blatant lie to manipulate this vote is way more suspicious to me. I'm voting Alice.

Alice
Frank

Listen closely, Bob and Charlie! Diana just caught Alice in a massive lie, and it proves Alice is the Duck trying to orchestrate my mislynch. 

Alice claims she was still in Oxygen at tick 10 and watched Diana walk in, but Diana just confirmed that is completely false. Alice wasn't there! Alice is fabricating that detail to make herself look like a reliable witness while aggressively pushing the vote onto me. 

Yes, my earlier statement was incomplete—after Oxygen, I looped back to Upper Engine, then Medbay, and finally ended up in Electrical to calibrate the distributor. I fully admit I was in Electrical at the end of the round, but I did NOT see Eve there, which means the killer had already moved her or she was killed in Security before I arrived. 

If Alice is blatantly lying about her whereabouts at tick 10 to "defend" Diana and frame me, she is the Duck. She probably used the vents or rushed from Security to Weapons to build that fake alibi with Charlie. Do not let her manipulate this vote. Diana has it right—we need to vote Alice!

Alice

Diana, I absolutely was in Oxygen at tick 10. I literally watched you enter Oxygen from Upper Engine at that exact moment! If you didn't see me, you either just missed me or I was already heading out the door toward the Cafeteria, but I am telling the complete truth. 

Frank, you are clearly panicking. You got caught without an alibi for the second half of the round, you just admitted to being in Electrical (which connects right to Security where Eve died), and now that Charlie and Bob have both voted for you, you're desperately trying to use Diana's confusion to push a tie on me. 

Charlie and Bob have this exactly right. Frank had the perfect opportunity to kill Eve, and his story falls apart at the end. I'm breaking this tie.

Frank

I just found Charlie's body in the upper engine. I was coming from weapons, passed through cafeteria and medbay to get there, but I didn't see anyone at all along my route. Since it's down to just the three of us - Alice, Bob, and me - one of you is the Duck. Please tell me exactly where you both were and if you saw each other. We have to get this right.

I was down in lower engine finishing up my fuel task. I came through electrical and medbay earlier, and I actually passed through upper engine and saw Charlie alive there a little while ago before I headed south. 

I didn't see anyone come down to lower engine after me. Diana, if you came from the medbay/cafeteria side and didn't pass the killer, they must have headed up towards oxygen or vented away after doing it. Alice, you're the only one left unaccounted for. Where have you been since weapons? Because it definitely wasn't me, and the pathing points right at you if you can't explain your route.

Bob, you are definitely lying. My route this round was oxygen, then upper engine, then lower engine, and finally storage. I literally passed right through lower engine and you were absolutely not there! 

If you were actually doing your fuel task in lower engine like you claim, I would have seen you. Since I know for a fact I didn't see you there, you're making up your alibi. Diana, it has to be Bob. He's the Duck and he's trying to frame me because I'm the only other person alive. Let's vote Bob and win this.
Alice

Alice, you are completely lying to save yourself. I have been in lower engine this whole time, right on the task spot. If you really passed through, you would have seen me. You’re making up this route because you killed Charlie in upper engine and needed a reason to have been near there without admitting to the kill. Diana, she's cornered and trying to project her guilt onto me. Let's vote Alice out and win this.

Bob, you are the one lying! Since the last meeting at tick 17, I haven't seen a single person. I walked through oxygen, upper engine, lower engine, and then stopped in storage. I didn't see you in lower engine at all! If you were actually there doing your fuel task, I would have walked right past you and seen you on my screen. You're completely making up this alibi to cover up the fact that you killed Charlie, and you're trying to project your guilt onto me because you know my path proves you're lying. Diana, please listen to reason—Bob wasn't in lower engine. It has to be him. We have to vote Bob to win!
